intro: This quest sends adventurers to recover Blind Mary's discarded looking glass for the astronomer Viktori Prism'Antras. The fragile mirror fell into the hands of an Insane Ghoul that wanders the desolate Tranquil Gardens Cemetery in southern Duskwood.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The looking glass was one of my finest treasures until... The incident. After that happened, I discarded it behind the barn. There was an Insane Ghoul who used to roam back there. Perhaps he picked it up. Rumor has it the devilish beast resides in the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I showed Cog the beginnings of our star-viewing machine. He was impressed. Did you happen to find a reflective device?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Most superb! This will work perfectly. Many thanks!
